build_two_tower_model_from_config: build a TwoTowerClassificationModel from a config and tensorizers using the from_config class method
trace_model_for_jit: trace the TwoTowerClassificationModel with sample inputs using torch.jit.trace for TorchScript export
torchscriptify_model_with_tensorizers: torchscriptify the traced model into a ScriptModule with tensorizers for classification predictions
